about: Read by scripts/terms.js. 'retired' terms must not appear on DM pages once their section is finished; 'voice' patterns mark decision voice or placeholders on world pages; 'moved' lists old page paths that must not be linked. 'scan' lists the top folders read; 'finished' lists the folders whose hits fail the check; everything else is reported as a warning. 'allow' holds 'path:regex' pairs for legitimate uses.

the world's name, or star-and-letter designation (CSC 16423 c)
GAL-02, the galaxy of the eldritch gods
the Astral Sea (the Fleet calls it the drift)
Distinction / Expansion / Consolidation (fragment); the Axioms are Consolidation, Expansion, Dissolution, Distinction, Determination

four great shards; 333 small black shards
Oerth (the Ascension World is Oerth, not a separate place)
